entries.evidence: Soul Fracture Rank Needed: 1 Mana Cost: 5 Mana Cooldown: 5 Seconds Type: Magical Range: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target. entries.evidence: Unleash Doom Rank Needed: 5 Mana Cost: 8 Mana Cooldown: 10 Seconds Type: Magical Range: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target. Description: Release calamitous shadows upon your target, inflicting them with Decay which negates all non lifesteal healing they receive for 3 seconds. If you have 10 stacks of Doom, they are consumed to apply Unleashed Doom, empowering your skills and increasing your outgoing damage by 25% and Haste by 50% for 8 seconds. Can't miss. If Unleashed Doom is activated or is already active, you Gather Darkness, empowering the next skill you use (except Necrotic Blade) with an additional effect. Note: Deals 120% weapon damage.

entries.officialDescription: Starting at rank 1, all skills (except Necrotic Blade) grant you 1 stack of Doom, which stacks to 10 and is used for Unleash Doom. While Unleashed Doom is active, you can't gain stacks of Doom. At rank 10, increases your Crit Chance by 10%.
